# Review of the project RTL to GDSII of a basic 2X1_MULTIPLEXER

## 1. SystemVerilog Source (`Mux_2x1.sv`)

```systemverilog
module Mux_2x1 (
    input logic i0,
    input logic i1,
    input logic sel,
    output logic out
);

    assign out = (sel) ? i1 : i0;

endmodule
```

## 3. 2x1 Multiplexer Constraints & STA Script

### 3.1 SDC Constraints File (`constraints.sdc`)

```tcl
#Constraint.sdc file 

# Input delays
set_input_delay 0 [all_inputs]

# Output delays
set_output_delay 0 [all_outputs]

# Driving cell
set_driving_cell -lib_cell sky130_fd_sc_hd__buf_1 [all_inputs]

# Output load
set_load 0.05 [all_outputs]
```

### 3.2 STA File (`sta.tcl`)

```
read_liberty /foss/pdks/sky130A/libs.ref/sky130_fd_sc_hd/lib/sky130_fd_sc_hd__tt_025C_1v80.lib
read_verilog Mux_2x1_sky130.v
link_design Mux_2x1
read_sdc constraints.sdc
report_checks
report_tns
report_wns
```
